title: Some sins don’t destroy you overnight.
paragraphs:
Some sins don’t destroy you overnight.
They destroy you slowly… in silence.

“When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.”
— Psalm 32:3–5

Hidden sin doesn’t stay hidden inside the soul.
It drains spiritual strength, steals peace, and slowly hardens the heart.

David said when he refused to confess, his strength dried up.
But the moment he confessed, God forgave.

Sin suffocates in the dark.
But confession brings light.

Stop hiding.
Bring it to God.
